sections.kicker: Prepared for Norra Collective by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Norra Collective has a recognisable painted world in its prints and a headline that could sit on any art shop.
sections.keep: The flowers. The tulips and poppies in flat colour look like one hand, and it is a clear style.

pins.area: The italic Curated Art headline over the left half of the room photo
pins.what: The headline is a category line in italic type across the photo.
pins.why: Curated art is what every print shop says, and it names no one and no point of view.
pins.how: Name the eye behind the curation and what it looks for.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: A shopper who wants something unusual finds the same sentence everywhere.

pins.area: Four framed flower prints in flat colour hung on one white wall
pins.what: Four framed prints of flowers on one wall look as though a single artist made them.
pins.why: That is the brand's strongest signal and the page does not name the artist or the idea.
pins.how: Say who makes these and why this style.
pins.label: Your prints
pins.cost: The one thing that sets Norra apart is shown and never explained.

pins.what: The menu sorts the shop by room and collection.
pins.why: It is the way furniture stores sort, and it hides the artists.
pins.how: Sort at least one path by artist or story.
pins.label: Your menu
pins.cost: Shoppers browse by room and never learn who made what.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Norra Collective's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
